name: master_bus_safe
eq_intent: Small corrective master moves only; no broad cuts pretending to be resonance control.
compression_intent: Glue compression 1.2:1 to 2:1, slow enough attack to preserve punch, 0.5 to 2 dB gain reduction.
de_esser_intent: Only for measured global sibilance; 6 to 9 kHz, max 1.5 dB reduction.
ms_eq_intent: Low sides controlled, center body protected, stereo harshness reduced without width collapse.
